newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares dip on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares dip on weak sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares dipped on Thursday on weaker sentiment depressed further by liquidation, brokers said.
The index ended down 0.097 points or 0.20 percent to 48.390 points on volume of 11.4 million shares worth $2.65 million. Of 41 B shares, 33 traded with 11 down, 16 flat and six up.
Brokers said liquidation selling in selective stocks recently depressed market sentiment further.
"The market remains very bearish with overseas investors withdrawing their capital," one broker said. "The situation will continue in the short term."
"The 48 point support level will be tested in the next few days with technical charts worsened," a second broker said.
The Shanghai China International Travel Service was the worst performer on some speculative selling, falling $0.012 or 3.50 percent to $0.330 on volume of 24,000 shares.
Shanghai Refrigerator Compressor followed due to institutional liquidation, falling $0.014 or 3.15 percent to $0.430 on volume of 540,000 shares.
Tientsin Marine traded the most on institutional cross-trading mostly at $0.310, but ending unchanged at $0.320 on volume of 1.0 million shares.
Shanghai A shares rose on active speculation in selective stocks, brokers said.

The A index ended up 19.865 points or 2.02 percent to 1001.727 points on volume of 783.5 million shares worth 6.6 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index rose 42.612 points or 1.68 percent to 2582.722 points.
Hunan Haili was the star on players' heavy speculative buying, surging 2.64 yuan or 23.97 percent to 13.65 yuan on volume of 4.7 million shares.
